inputs.root_cause: Event 220's exact_next_action named the version/srcLang-omission test cluster as a next candidate. Investigation found version/srcLang omission were already correctly refused at parse time (untested), while trgLang-required-when-target-present was genuinely unbuilt (zero references in validator.py).
inputs.obligation_targeted: SAL-XLIFF-OBL-C96F6CB613A6F95D (XLIFF-PARSE-001) and SAL-XLIFF-OBL-2602F9167F95464B (XLIFF-TEXT-001), identical rule_text -- both promoted missing->partial
inputs.acceptance_evidence: 8 new tests: 3 prove version/srcLang omission is already correctly refused at parse time (2 negative, 1 positive control), 5 prove the newly-built trgLang-required-when-target-present validation (violation, valid, no-target-optional, empty-target-still-counts, multi-unit scope).
inputs.regression_tier: full xliff package suite (tests/python/xliff) plus 6-format regression

execution_steps: 1. Read the obligation register's rule_text for the 2-obligation cluster: 'version and srcLang attributes are required on the xliff root. trgLang is optional in the XSD but required by the core Schematron when target elements are present.'

2. Read reader.py directly: version omission (root.get('version','') not in SUPPORTED_VERSIONS) and srcLang omission (not source_language) both already raise XliffParseError at parse time -- confirmed correct, just untested.
3. Grepped validator.py for 'trgLang' -- zero matches, confirming the obligation's own claim of zero implementation.

4. Read the pinned XLIFF 2.1 schematron directly (.local/format-contracts/acquired/xliff/src-xlf-002.bin, schemas/xliff_core_2.1.sch), pattern F1: 'The trgLang attribute is required if and only if the XLIFF Document contains target elements that are children of segment or ignorable' -- confirmed the formal rule only asserts ONE direction (target present => trgLang required); no sibling rule asserts the reverse, so this slice deliberately does not invent that direction despite the obligation's own 'if and only if' phrasing.
5. Confirmed segment.target is not None iff the reader found a real <target> element (even empty) by reading reader.py's segment-parsing loop directly.

6. Added _document_has_target_content(value) to validator.py: walks every file/unit/segment in the document checking segment.target is not None. Wired an xliff.trgLang.required diagnostic into validate(), right after the existing srcLang check.

7. Verified interactively before writing formal tests: version-omitted and srcLang-omitted both correctly raise XliffParseError; target-present/no-trgLang is a violation; target-present/trgLang-set is valid; no-target/no-trgLang is valid; empty <target/> still counts as present -- all 6 cases correct on the first attempt.
8. Ran the full pre-existing xliff suite (389 tests, zero new fixtures) against the new check to look for false positives before writing a single new test -- all 389 passed unchanged.
9. Wrote 8 formal tests, all passing on the first attempt.

10. Ran ruff (clean), the full xliff suite (397 passed, was 389, +8), and the full 6-format regression (3304 passed, was 3296, +8; same 4 pre-existing unrelated safetensors interop failures, 2 skipped) confirming zero cross-format regression.

11. Ran skills-first governance: resolve -> add-python-api (COMPOSE_EXISTING_SKILLS), manifest create --write (sfx-d3beec3e9e7fa4f8, confirmed as the actually-persisted manifest via ls -t .local/skills-first/manifests/), hand-written receipt YAML, closeout --close -> CLOSE_OK.
tests_run: .venv/Scripts/pytest tests/python/xliff/ -q -- 397 passed, was 389 passed (389 passed unchanged BEFORE writing new tests, confirming zero false positives)

.venv/Scripts/pytest tests/python/ipynb tests/python/ora tests/python/nrrd tests/python/xliff tests/python/safetensors tests/python/ubl -q -- 3304 passed, 2 skipped, 4 preexisting unrelated safetensors interop failures, was 3296 passed

evidence.oracle: SELF-CONSISTENT format_factory-only evidence per the execution-recovery directive's GAP-008 rule; every claim grounded directly in the pinned reader source and the pinned XLIFF 2.1 schematron text.
evidence.obligations_moved_breakdown: SAL-XLIFF-OBL-C96F6CB613A6F95D (XLIFF-PARSE-001) and SAL-XLIFF-OBL-2602F9167F95464B (XLIFF-TEXT-001) both missing->partial. Stays partial, not implemented: the reverse direction (trgLang present but no target elements => invalid) is not asserted by the schematron itself and is deliberately not implemented, so the obligation's own 'if and only if' phrasing is only half-covered by design.
